title: In-vehicle cameras – data protection
subtitle: What is recorded, why, and what rights you have

driver_privacy_notice.title: Privacy notice for the use of road safety technologies

other_road_users_notice.title: Privacy notice on road traffic accidents

blocks.text: Our delivery vehicles are fitted with a camera-based road safety system. It does not record continuously, but exclusively on an event-triggered basis – a recording is only created once a safety-relevant event is detected. When an incident occurs, both image and sound are recorded. In this course we explain in plain language what is recorded, who sees the data, how long it is stored and what rights you have.

blocks.title: Important upfront
blocks.text: At the end you confirm that you have received the privacy notice. This is not a consent and not an approval.

blocks.title: The course takes about 10 minutes and covers
items: how the cameras work and when a recording is created in the first place
which data about you is processed
why we do this and on what legal basis
who can see the data
how long it is stored
your rights as a data subject

blocks.text: The system consists of cameras facing outwards towards the road and inwards into the driver's cab, plus sensors that measure driving behaviour. The key point is: the sensors detect certain safety events – and only such an event triggers a recording.

blocks.title: What does NOT happen
items: There is no livestream. Nobody watches you drive in real time.
There is no gapless surveillance. Your trip is not continuously observed or assessed.
There is no continuous picture or sound recording and no continuous upload – neither of the road nor of the driver's cab.
There is NO CONTINUOUS LISTENING. Sound is not recorded permanently, but only when an incident triggers a recording.
The system does not assess you automatically with consequences under employment law. A human being reviews every incident.

blocks.title: What does happen
items: At an incident the system records image and sound on an event-triggered basis – that is, only when a safety-relevant event is detected (e.g. hard braking, tailgating, distraction).
As long as no event is detected, no recording is created that would be stored or transmitted.
Only after a detected event are the associated image and sound recordings transmitted and available for review.
You can see these events yourself in the app – together with the associated recordings.

blocks.title: Do not cover the camera
blocks.text: Covering or repositioning the camera is registered by the system as an event. Please keep the camera clear. If you have questions about the processing of your data, please contact the office named in the data protection section.

modules.title: Which data about you is processed

blocks.text: The following categories of personal data may be processed about you:

items.key: Event-triggered image and sound recordings (at incidents)
items.value: image and sound recordings of the road environment and of the vehicle interior that are created exclusively upon a detected safety event – no continuous picture or sound recording
location, speed, acceleration, braking, cornering, distance to the vehicle ahead

speeding, harsh braking and acceleration, collisions, tailgating, distracted driving, drowsiness, camera obstruction, forward collision warnings, rolling stops, violations of traffic signs or traffic lights
your interactions with the system and the app

blocks.title: Health data – only in exceptional cases
blocks.text: In the event of a serious road traffic accident, health data may exceptionally be processed, for example visible injuries in the images. The legal basis in that case is Art. 9(2)(f) GDPR – the establishment or defence of legal claims.

blocks.title: Purposes of the processing
items: improving road safety – for you and for other road users
analysing road traffic incidents and assessing legal claims
complying with legal obligations

blocks.text: The legal basis is our legitimate interest under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Specifically, this concerns the protection of health and physical integrity, the reduction of legal, financial and reputational risks arising from road traffic accidents, and the investigation of accidents. Where we comply with legal obligations, we rely on Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR.

blocks.title: No consent
blocks.text: We do not rely on your consent. In an employment relationship, consent would be legally challengeable. Instead we have carried out a data protection impact assessment and documented the balancing of interests.

blocks.title: Recipients
items: our road safety technology provider (camera hardware, cloud platform, driver app)
authorities and public bodies, such as courts or law enforcement agencies, in the context of proceedings
insurers and contractual partners, including their lawyers, where incidents or legal claims are concerned

blocks.text: Internally, only those people see the data who need it for their task – for example to debrief a safety event or to handle an accident.

blocks.title: Transfers to third countries
blocks.text: As a rule, your data stays within the EU or the EEA. Where we transfer data to our provider in the USA, we rely on the EU standard contractual clauses pursuant to Art. 46(2)(c) GDPR. In addition, the data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

items.key: Event-triggered images stored locally in the vehicle
items.value: a few days, then automatically overwritten

items.key: Image and sound recordings of safety events in the cloud
items.value: a few weeks, then automatically deleted

items.key: Material relating to accidents and legal claims
items.value: until the limitation period expires or the proceedings are concluded

blocks.text: Once the retention periods have expired, the data is deleted or anonymised.

items.value: You can find out which data we process about you.
You can request the erasure of your data.
You can have the processing restricted.
You can object to the processing in accordance with Art. 21 GDPR.
You can lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

blocks.text: You can exercise all of these rights at any time via the "Data protection" section of the app. There you will find the contact details of the responsible office. Your request will be handled within the statutory time limit.

When an event triggers a recording, other road users may also incidentally be seen or heard on the outward-facing recordings. Faces and licence plates are automatically pixelated in this material. Non-pixelated material is only retained and reviewed if a road traffic accident or comparable circumstances have occurred.

blocks.title: If you are asked at the scene of an accident
blocks.text: Refer the parties involved in the accident to our privacy notice on road traffic accidents. You will find it in the app in the data protection section and can show it to them directly.

acknowledgement.headline: Acknowledgement of receipt
acknowledgement.intro: Please confirm that you have received and noted the privacy notice.
acknowledgement.statement: I confirm that I have received and noted the privacy notice for the use of road safety technologies and driver safety tools in the version dated {{documentDate}}.
acknowledgement.clarification: I am aware that this confirmation does not constitute consent to the data processing. The processing takes place on the basis of legitimate interests.
acknowledgement.systemNote: For context: the system does not record continuously. Recordings are created exclusively on an event-triggered basis when safety-relevant events are detected; at an incident, image and sound are recorded. No livestream, no gapless surveillance, no continuous picture or sound recording.
acknowledgement.signatureLegalNote: Your signature confirms solely the receipt and acknowledgement of the privacy notice – it is not a consent to the data processing.
acknowledgement.declineLabel: I do not wish to confirm
acknowledgement.declineExplanation: That is fine. In that case we will simply record that the privacy notice was handed over to you and that you did not sign the confirmation.
acknowledgement.declineNote: Privacy notice handed over on {{datum}} via the CoDriver app. The driver did not sign the acknowledgement of receipt.
acknowledgement.successText: Your acknowledgement of receipt has been saved. You can find the privacy notice and your record at any time in the data protection section.
acknowledgement.declinedText: We have recorded that the privacy notice was handed over to you and that you did not sign the confirmation.
